title: Two defaults
prompt: Both of area_with_defaults's parameters have defaults: width is 4 and height is 3 unless the caller says otherwise. Return width times height. The tests call area_with_defaults with no values, one value and two.
hints: With one value passed, only the first parameter changes; the second keeps its default.
solution:
func area_with_defaults(width = 4, height = 3):
	return width * height
